text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT  :-(English) 1) TO BE TOUGHENED UPTO 28-32 HRC. 2) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"The note specifies the hardness range but does not state at which manufacturing stage the heat treatment is to be applied (e.g., after rough machining, before final grinding). Without a defined stage the shop cannot sequence operations correctly, risking distortion of finished features or inability to machine hardened material. The designer should add the process stage to the heat-treatment callout.","recommended_correction":"Revise N3 to specify when the toughening is performed relative to machining and surface treatment steps."},{"rule_id":"TL-002","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D6","page":1,"quote":"⌀20"}],"comment":"The ⌀20 diameter on page 1 carries no tolerance or fit callout, yet as the main body of a stop pin it is a functional mating feature that must fit into a corresponding hole. Leaving it to general tolerances risks an unpredictable fit in assembly. The designer should add an appropriate fit or explicit tolerance to D6.","recommended_correction":"Add a fit designation or dimensional tolerance to dimension D6 for the pin's mating diameter."}]}
